results.title: FreshLab-Tomato: A Longitudinal Shelf-Life Dataset
results.description: FreshLab-Tomato is a longitudinal image and environmental dataset developed to support research on tomato shelf-life assessment and spoilage prediction. The dataset contains 1,080 images collected from 12 individual tomatoes monitored over 10 consecutive days under three storage conditions: ambient, refrigerated, and outdoor.

results.title: Multimodal perishable fruits and vegetables dataset
results.description: Comprehensive lifecycle coverage: The dataset documents the full lifecycle of fruits, from the unripe stage to the visible spoilage stage, using multimodal data. Measurements are captured three times daily—morning, afternoon, and evening—recording natural variations in temperature, color, and methane emission patterns.

results.title: GitHub - laboroai/LaboroTomato
results.description: Laboro Tomato is an image dataset of growing tomatoes at different stages of their ripening which is designed for object detection and instance segmentation tasks. We also provide two subsets of tomatoes separated by size. Dataset was gathered at a local farm with two separate cameras with its different resolution and image quality.
